response.reason: The Quake-style seed plus two Newton refinements gives rsqrt relative error ~1e-7, and with FP32 arithmetic on FP16 inputs (x*x rounding relative error ~1e-7), the absolute error of x/sqrt(1+x^2) stays well under 1e-6 across the whole domain (values are bounded by 1). Edge cases (zeros, subnormals, ±65504, squared_length ≥ 1 so bitcast sign bit is 0) are all handled correctly.
